brand.description: Scriptora is an academic service platform helping students with thesis writing, proposals, and full research support from Honours through PhD level.

services.name: Thesis Writing
services.description: Full support from topic selection to final formatting, Honours through PhD.

services.name: Research Proposal
services.description: Problem statement through methodology, ready for committee review.

services.name: SPSS Data Analysis
services.description: Hypothesis testing, regression, and full statistical analysis.

services.name: Turnitin / Plagiarism Check
services.description: Similarity report checks to help ensure originality before submission.

services.name: Grammar & Proofreading
services.description: Language, grammar, and formatting review for academic documents.

services.name: Citation & Referencing
services.description: APA, MLA, Chicago, and other citation styles formatted correctly.

workflow.title: Consultation
workflow.description: Share your topic, level, and deadline with our team.

workflow.title: Quote & Package
workflow.description: Receive a package and price based on scope and timeline.

workflow.title: Writing & Drafts
workflow.description: Your writer works in stages, with drafts shared for review.

workflow.title: Final Delivery
workflow.description: Formatted, checked, and delivered on your deadline.

deliveryPolicy.summary: Deadlines are agreed at order time and are flexible where possible; urgent turnarounds can be discussed with the team.

revisionPolicy.summary: Unlimited revisions within 30 days of delivery, as long as the request stays within the original scope.

refundPolicy.summary: Refund eligibility depends on work progress at the time of cancellation — contact support to review your specific order.

paymentPolicy.summary: Payments can be made in installments; bKash, Nagad, and card payments are accepted.
